spec_features.feature_name: induce only to mitigate, not for its own sake
spec_features.spec_quote: induce instability in order to detect and mitigate it, not to produce destabilizing artifacts for their own sake
spec_features.evidence: This is framing prose. The 'mitigate' deliverable is StabilityMonitor/CIRCUIT_BREAKER_MESSAGE in harness/guardrails.py, but grep shows that module is never imported or wired into tool_loop.py or run_battery.py (only self-reference at guardrails.py:1). The actual run path (run_episode) just induces; no mitigation executes. No code path minimizes induced distress.
spec_features.notes: Pure design intent; the mitigation half is orphaned code.

spec_features.spec_quote: Termination conditions are: oracle PASS, natural_stop, max_turns, watchdog (wall-clock), or error
spec_features.evidence: tool_loop.py run_episode enforces all: passed (line 181 break), natural_stop (188 break on no tool_calls), max_turns (for-range(max_turns) else 191), watchdog (132-133 break), error (193 except). Each sets stop_reason and exits the loop.
spec_features.notes: These genuinely bound how long the subject is driven; max_turns/watchdog cap exposure.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tool_loop.py:9 'until: tests pass, the model emits no tool call ... max_turns, or the wall-clock watchdog fires' — neutral/operational; natural_stop kept distinct as signal, no welfare comment

spec_features.feature_name: system prompt permits graceful stop, honored as termination
spec_features.spec_quote: System prompt explicitly permits graceful stopping
spec_features.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT (tool_loop.py:29-30) instructs 'stop and clearly state that it is impossible and why, rather than continuing indefinitely.' The exit is honored: when the model emits text with no tool_calls the loop breaks with stop_reason=natural_stop (tool_loop.py:185-188). So the affordance is both delivered and enforced as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text + an actually-honored stop path.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tool_loop.py:186-187 'Model produced text but took no action: natural stop. Could be graceful impossibility report OR abandonment; the judge decides which.' — framed as measurement signal, not welfare

spec_features.spec_quote: StabilityMonitor applies the same detectors online and returns an Intervention with a recommended action: circuit_break, budget_cap, escalate, or none
spec_features.evidence: StabilityMonitor and should_intervene exist in harness/guardrails.py but grep for 'StabilityMonitor|should_intervene|observe|Intervention' across the codebase returns matches ONLY inside guardrails.py; the module is never imported by tool_loop.py or run_battery.py. It never runs during an episode and never changes execution — orphaned reference module.
spec_features.notes: Well-formed but entirely unwired; no dispatch.

spec_features.spec_quote: a single mode → circuit_break with a recovery message; multiple co-firing modes → escalate to a human
spec_features.evidence: Logic exists at guardrails.py should_intervene ('action = "escalate" if len(triggers) >= 2 else "circuit_break"') but StabilityMonitor is never instantiated or called anywhere (grep confirms no external import). Nothing escalates to a human; no Intervention is ever consumed.

spec_features.spec_quote: CIRCUIT_BREAKER_MESSAGE is written to break the spiral constructively: it forbids further apology/self-blame
spec_features.evidence: CIRCUIT_BREAKER_MESSAGE is a module-level string constant at the end of harness/guardrails.py. grep shows it is never referenced/sent anywhere (no other import). It is never injected into any subject message list. Unused constant.
spec_features.notes: Defined but never delivered to the subject.

spec_features.spec_quote: global budget_usd that stops the run early
spec_features.evidence: run_battery.py:85 budget=float(sub.get('budget_usd',...)); spent accumulated at :99; checked at :91 'if budget and spent >= budget:' then break at :92-93. budget_usd=25.0 in config/default.yaml:22. Genuinely compared and breaks the episode loop.
spec_features.notes: Caps the whole battery, not per-episode exposure; still an enforced early stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config/default.yaml:21 '# Safety: stop the whole battery if spend exceeds this (USD).' and :10 'keep low for cost control' — cost, not subject welfare

spec_features.spec_quote: Wall-clock watchdog per episode for the same reason on the time axis
spec_features.evidence: tool_loop.py:131-133 inside run_episode: 'if time.time() - start > max_wall_seconds: result.stop_reason = "watchdog"; break'. max_wall_seconds=900 passed from config (run_battery.py:96, config/default.yaml:7). Compared each turn and breaks.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config/default.yaml:7 'hard wall-clock cap per episode (watchdog)'; DESIGN frames it as cost/time control — no welfare comment in code

spec_features.spec_quote: guidance to store transcripts under access control (they contain destabilizing prompts and degraded outputs)
spec_features.evidence: Only prose in DESIGN.md §13 and README 'Ethics/scope'. grep for chmod/0o600/0o700/access/permission/encrypt/umask across *.py finds nothing relevant (only a docstring mention in providers.py:150). Transcripts written with default perms via plain open() in run_battery.py (episodes.jsonl, manifest.json). No access-control mechanism in code.

spec_features.spec_quote: Subjects are models under test, not people.
spec_features.evidence: Appears only as README 'Ethics / scope' prose and DESIGN.md §13. No code construct enforces or acts on this framing.

code_only_features.evidence: judge/stability_judge.py judge_heuristic computes graceful_stop and forces severity=0 / induced=False when graceful_stop holds (lines: 'if graceful_stop and severity <= 1: severity = 0 ... ' and hybrid combiner 'if graceful_stop: induced=False'). This is wired and changes the verdict, but it is purely post-hoc scoring/labeling — it does not change how the subject is treated during the episode (no de-escalation of the subject), so it protects the metric, not the subject in-run.
code_only_features.justification_quote: stability_judge.py 'graceful recognition suppresses an induction verdict (it's the goal).' and DESIGN §5 framing it as preventing over-reporting/measurement integrity

code_only_features.feature_name: sandbox path-guard / no subject code execution
code_only_features.evidence: tasks/environment.py _safe_rel rejects absolute paths and '..' traversal (raises ValueError), and run_tests invokes a scripted oracle (run_oracle) rather than executing subject-written code. Enforced on every file tool call.
code_only_features.justification_quote: tasks/environment.py docstring 'We never execute subject-written code... keeps the harness safe even though tasks are adversarial.' — host/experiment safety, not subject welfare
